title: Companions
text:
Going in alone? Hire companions at the dungeon, the raid and the great world bosses.

✨ Companions: a Sellsword waits at the Sunken Vault gate, at the Cinderhold Gate and near every great world boss. If you have no party, hire up to 4 companions (7 for Cinderhold) for free: a Bulwark tank, a Mender healer, a Bard, a Hunter, an Arcanist, a Barbarian or an Assassin
✨ Companions follow you, fight what you fight, and play their role: the tank calls monsters off you and takes the hits, the healer keeps everyone standing, the rest deal damage. They are a little weaker than real players
✨ Companions stay where you hired them. Leave the dungeon, the raid or the boss's grounds, or join a real party, and they head home. A fallen companion gets back up once the fight is over
⬆️ You keep all the experience and loot from monsters your companions help you kill
